logMeal.notInFoodDbPatch: not in food DB — pass kcal/p/f/c overrides or the agent will resolve it
logMeal.notInFoodDbItem: not in food DB — agent will need to add it first or you can pass kcal/p/f/c overrides
logMeal.onlyTheseChange: Only these items change — the rest of the meal is left as-is.
logMeal.onlyThisChanges: Only this item changes — the rest of the meal is left as-is.
logMeal.noItems: No items yet. Click "add item" to start.

bodyComp.howMeasuredInfo: Pick a direct method (DEXA / BIA / caliper) to type a reading, or Navy to enter a tape measure and let the app estimate it.
bodyComp.tapeMeasurements: Tape measurements — the Navy body-fat % is computed from these.
bodyComp.hipInfo: Widest point. Required for the Navy estimate on women.
bodyComp.setHeight: Set your height in the profile to preview the estimate.
bodyComp.notesPlaceholder: Time of day, hydration, anything affecting the reading…

food.name: Name
food.nameInfo: Canonical snake_case id, e.g. chicken_thigh_roasted. This is how the food is referenced everywhere.
food.unitInfo: Macros are stored per 100 g/ml. Use pieces for count-based items.
food.gramsPerPieceInfo: Weight of one piece, so per-100g macros convert to a count.
food.gramsPerServingInfo: Weight of one serving/scoop in grams — lets 'one serving' resolve without asking.
food.barcodeInfo: UPC/EAN/GTIN digits — lets a future scan resolve this instantly.

pantry.writeModeInfo: Merge updates only the fields you set on each item and leaves the rest of the pantry alone. Replace all rebuilds the entire pantry from just the items listed here — anything not listed is removed.
pantry.replaceWarning: Replace wipes every pantry item not in the list below.
pantry.gramsPerPieceInfo: Weight of one piece, so per-100g macros convert to a count.

import.importInfo: Add to stock: purchased quantities are added to what you already have (a shopping trip). Overwrite: stock is set to these exact amounts (a full stocktake).
import.autoFetch: Auto-fetch macros for new barcoded items
import.autoFetchHint: Looks up OpenFoodFacts for items with a barcode but no macros.

recipe.recipeInfo: A reusable bundle of ingredients you can log as one meal. Servings divides the totals so a batch-cooked recipe shows per-serving macros.
recipe.name: Name
recipe.openRecipe: Open recipe in a new tab
recipe.enterValidUrl: Enter a valid https URL to open
recipe.instructionsPlaceholder:
Markdown — title each phase in **bold**, steps numbered. e.g.
**Caramel cream**
1. Whip the cream.
2. Fold in the **dulce de leche**.

**Assembly**
1. Layer biscuits, banana, cream.
2. Chill **2 h**.
recipe.noIngredients: No ingredients yet. Add foods from your pantry — macros resolve live.
recipe.absoluteForPortion: Absolute for this portion — overrides the pantry. Leave blank to resolve live from the pantry.
recipe.servingOfTarget: One serving is {{pct}}% of your {{kcal}} kcal day — about {{servings}} fit your target.
recipe.starRecipe: Star this recipe so it floats to the top of your list.

logRecipe.title: Log recipe
logRecipe.titleInfo: Freezes the recipe's ingredients into your log as one grouped meal, scaled by how much you ate.
logRecipe.unresolved_one: {{count}} ingredient can't resolve against your pantry — fix its food first, or the recipe logs zeros.
logRecipe.unresolved_other: {{count}} ingredients can't resolve against your pantry — fix their foods first, or the recipe logs zeros.
logRecipe.amountInfo: How many servings you ate. ½ = half a serving, 2 = two servings.
logRecipe.gramsInfo: Weight of the finished dish you ate. Logged as a share of the batch's total ingredient weight.
